::: {.work-intro}
Each case study starts with a question about a real structure and follows the work from idea to evidence. Bridge monitoring at LPI in Germany comes first.

The next three follow one line of research on corrosion in steel lock gates: simulating it, quantifying its risk, and updating the model with measurements. The final case study explores damage diagnosis across similar structures.
:::

## Other Work

Smaller projects and collaborations that do not have a full case study.

Composite Wing-Spar Debonding · UC San Diego, 2020
: My first research project: Abaqus models of debonding in composite wing spars, and a deep-learning surrogate that predicts strain response across different debonding locations and sizes. Research assistant.

Value of Information for Structural Monitoring · EURODYN 2026
: When does monitoring a prestressed bridge with stress-corrosion-cracking risk pay off? Coauthor. [Publication](publications.qmd#conf-voi)

Sensor-Fault Classification · IWSHM 2025
: Matched-filtering methods to classify faults in structural-monitoring sensor networks. Coauthor. [Publication](publications.qmd#conf-sensor)

Damage Detection Under Changing Temperature · IWSHM 2025
: On a steel lattice mast near Hannover, adversarial data normalization kept a damage classifier working at temperatures it was not trained on, raising accuracy from 61% to 83% without new labels. Lead author, with J.-H. Bartels; data from Leibniz University Hannover. [Publication](publications.qmd#conf-normalization)

River-Routing Calibration · Journal of Hydroinformatics, 2023
: Machine-learning-enabled calibration of river-routing model parameters. Coauthor. [Publication](publications.qmd#journal-river)
:::
